description: Add a book: paste an Amazon (paperback or hardcover), Apple Books or Bookshop.org link, an ISBN, or the title. We add the cover, title and author, and one Buy button that opens Amazon, Bookshop.org, Barnes & Noble, Apple Books (when known) and a library search. The owner's affiliate tags (update_profile amazonTag and bookshopId) are added to the Amazon and Bookshop.org links.

book.description: A store link, an ISBN, or the title (and author).

endsAt.description: When it stops showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

spotlight.description: Put it in the spotlight: shown first on the page, highlighted. Only one block has it; this takes it from any other.

startsAt.description: When it starts showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

name: add_book
title: Add a book button
